status: candidate_under_independent_review; literature audit does not validate proof or priority

candidate_theorem.quantifiers: For every finite dimension, faithful state sigma, and sigma-preserving CPTP Phi with an exact symmetric two-output channel extension, assuming the KMS adjoint H=Phi* is KMS-self-adjoint, one sigma-preserving EB channel Psi depending only on Phi and sigma satisfies both stated full KMS operator orders.
candidate_theorem.supplied_information: Phi, sigma, and an exact two-output extension; the comparator is asserted independent of reference A and correlations.
candidate_theorem.cost_or_norm: Weighted KMS operator order; this is not a diamond-norm bound.

conditional_consequence.statement: For a fixed rho_AB and an actual B-local two-output broadcaster with both AB marginals within half-trace error b of rho_AB, a single B-local EB Lambda depending only on the broadcaster and rho_B is claimed to satisfy half-trace reconstruction error <= 72 sqrt((I(A:B)_rho + 1)/ln(1/b)).
conditional_consequence.status: Parent-supplied assembled claim; not independently reconstructed in this literature task.
limitations: State-specific joint trace metric, not diamond norm.
The information budget is von Neumann I(A:B) for one state, not Holevo capacity over an ensemble.
EB output is separable; closeness to a quantum-classical state does not follow from EB alone.
No many-fragment common pointer POVM or spectrum-broadcasting claim follows automatically.

strongest_direct_prior.statement: A k-Bose-symmetric-extendible channel admits an EB approximation with diamond error <= dim(B)/k.
strongest_direct_prior.mismatch: Requires output support in the fully symmetric subspace and carries dimension cost; it does not give the candidate KMS order for general two-self-compatible reversible channels.

additional_prior_interfaces: Piani arXiv:1608.02650v1 Theorem 5 gives the exact local-broadcasting iff quantum-classical boundary, not a robust dimension-free bound.
Petz 1986 Theorem 4 and Ahmad-Klinger arXiv:2411.07288v1 Theorem 3.2 give exact sufficiency/recovery from relative-entropy equality, not an EB comparator.
Heinosaari et al. arXiv:1504.05768v2 distinguish pairwise measurement compatibility from full incompatibility breaking and EB.
Brandao-Piani-Horodecki arXiv:1310.8640v2 Theorem 1 gives many-fragment diamond approximation with explicit input-dimension cost and a shared POVM.
decisive_missing_gate: Prove or refute that a single sigma-preserving EB map can satisfy both full KMS operator inequalities for every legal finite-dimensional reversible self-compatible channel. The state trace conversion is a separate gate.
early_falsification_test: Use a full-rank non-maximally-mixed sigma and an explicit reversible thermal qubit channel with a symmetric two-output extension; test feasibility of both operator orders against the unrestricted EB Choi cone.
historical_significance_if_proved: Would give a dimension-free, bounded-mutual-information robust local-broadcasting-to-EB-reconstruction principle for two outputs, with the comparator fixed by the local channel and its stationary marginal; this would be a separability conclusion, not the exact quantum-classical no-local-broadcasting characterization.
